crossRefs.note: The children of Joseph spoke to Joshua, saying, “Why have you given me just one lot and one part for an inheritance…

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: Joshua spoke to the house of Joseph, that is, to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, “You are a numerous people, and have great power. You shall not have one lot only;
translations.bsb: So Joshua said to the house of Joseph—to Ephraim and Manasseh—“You have many people and great strength. You shall not have just one allotment,
translations.kjv: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power: thou shalt not have one lot
translations.asv: And Joshua spake unto the house of Joseph, even to Ephraim and to Manasseh, saying, Thou art a great people, and hast great power; thou shalt not have one lot only:
